name: NGC 185
tagline: NGC 147's sibling — an Andromeda dwarf spheroidal notable for dust and young stars rare in its class.

facts.label: Content
facts.value: Dust + a sprinkling of young stars

history: NGC 185 breaks the dwarf-spheroidal stereotype: unlike most old-star smudges it contains detectable dust, molecular gas and a small population of recently formed stars, implying it held onto gas far longer than its peers. As an M31 satellite it endures the giant's tides — its structure shows a mildly disturbed halo, a record of recent pericentric passage through Andromeda's halo.
